permission_mode.name: Permission Mode
permission_mode.hint: Keep deny_list (empty deny list = accept all).

user_deny_list.name: User deny list
user_deny_list.hint: Keep empty = accept all PTT input.

owner_id.name: Owner session ID
owner_id.hint: Session id used in the DM session key.

owner_nickname.name: Owner nickname
owner_nickname.hint: Name the bot sees for voice input.

ptt_mode.name: PTT mode
ptt_mode.hint: hold = talk while held; toggle = press to start/stop.

zh.name: 按键模式
zh.hint: 按住说话 / 按一下切换

hotkey.name: Hotkey
hotkey.hint: Single key, combo (ctrl+shift+v) or mouse x2/x3.

hotkey_require_focus.name: Only when VRChat focused
hotkey_require_focus.hint: Ignore the hotkey unless VRChat is the focused window.

zh.name: 仅 VRChat 前台时触发

mic_device.name: Microphone device
mic_device.default: 【系统默认】跟随 Windows 设置
mic_device.hint: 16 kHz-capable inputs; first item = system default.

zh.name: 麦克风设备
zh.hint: 选真实麦克风；首项=跟随系统

mic_gain.name: Microphone gain
mic_gain.hint: 1.0 = unchanged; 2-5 helps quiet mics, too high clips.

stt_model.name: STT model
stt_model.hint: Empty = KiraAI default STT. Pick another to override.

stt_timeout_seconds.name: STT timeout (seconds)
stt_timeout_seconds.hint: Give up on a single recognition after this long.

silence_skip_dbfs.name: Silence skip (dBFS)
silence_skip_dbfs.hint: Skip recognition below this peak level; 0 disables.

disable_tools.name: Disable tools in game
disable_tools.hint: Faster replies; tools unavailable in game.

zh.name: 游戏内禁用工具
zh.hint: 更快，但用不了搜索等工具

osc_in_port.name: VRChat OSC input port
osc_in_port.hint: UDP port VRChat listens on for chatbox.

send_interval.name: Segment interval (seconds)
send_interval.hint: Minimum gap between chatbox segments; keep >= 1.

read_chars_per_second.name: Reading speed (chars/sec)
read_chars_per_second.hint: Paces multi-segment replies; 5 suits casual Chinese.

max_segment_interval.name: Max segment interval (seconds)
max_segment_interval.hint: Upper bound for the gap between segments.

reply_prefix.name: Reply prefix
reply_prefix.hint: Prefixed to every chatbox line (e.g. yuki：).

send_timeout_seconds.name: Pipeline reply timeout (seconds)
send_timeout_seconds.hint: Return to idle if the pipeline never replies.

log_conversations.name: Log conversations
log_conversations.hint: Append recognized text and replies to a local jsonl.
